content.title: About
content.content: Baby Toddler multiple fruit, Stage 3 is a baby food product containing a blend of several fruits, designed for the third stage of complementary feeding. The product undergoes strict quality control, contains no artificial additives, and is suitable for infants from 6 months old.

content.title: Interesting Facts
items: The blend includes apple, pear, banana and peach, providing a variety of flavors and nutrients.
All fruits are gently heat‑treated at low temperatures to preserve maximum vitamins.
The product is free from gluten, lactose and added sugar, making it safe for sensitive babies.
Packaging is made from recyclable material and meets environmental standards.

items.title: Rich in vitamin C
items.content: Vitamin C supports the immune system and aids iron absorption.

items.title: Source of dietary fiber
items.content: Fiber promotes healthy digestion and helps maintain a feeling of fullness.

items.title: Contains potassium
items.content: Potassium helps maintain fluid balance and normal heart function.

items.title: Contains antioxidants
items.content: Fruit antioxidants protect cells from oxidative stress.

items.title: Supports growth
items.content: B‑vitamins and minerals contribute to normal nervous system development and child growth.

items.title: Fruit allergy
items.content: Some infants may have an allergic reaction to individual fruits in the blend.

items.title: Not for infants under 6 months
items.content: The product is intended for babies who have already started complementary feeding.

items.title: Storage after opening
items.content: Once opened, keep the container refrigerated and use within 48 hours.

content.title: How to Eat
content.content: The meal is ready to serve straight from the pack. If needed, thin with a small amount of breast milk or formula to achieve the desired consistency.

content.title: Storage
content.content: Store the unopened package in a dry, cool place away from direct sunlight. After opening, keep refrigerated and consume within 48 hours.
